scope: Declarative source-derived parity fixtures; no tokens, account IDs, signing keys or native results. This is not an executable policy evaluator.
references_are: Repository-relative source evidence; runtime expectations require native confirmation.

cases.scenario: Valid Active HS256 JWS without exp; current durable row, stamps and entitlement projection
cases.expected_details: Populate hash/webKey/ActiveSession and protocol/family/generation headers; do not require exp.

cases.scenario: Old access hash after committed family rotation, with stale cache
cases.expected_details: Trust rejects old hash/generation; clear AppStatus; never refresh from generic middleware.

cases.scenario: Committed logout/revoke before authority lookup; stale cache still present
cases.expected_details: SESSION_NOT_FOUND; best-effort cache removal; protected Authenticate returns 401.

cases.scenario: Token has pending purpose and exists only in pending_two_factor_sessions
cases.expected_details: No sessions row; cannot become Active.

cases.scenario: access_expiration equals or precedes now; family lifetime still future
cases.expected_details: CLIENT_CLEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN; cache revoke only, independent refresh lifetime preserved.

cases.scenario: session_expiration equals or precedes now
cases.expected_details: Hard expiration rejects even with valid signature.

cases.scenario: Session cutoff equals or precedes now, all other lifetimes future
cases.expected_details: EffectiveSessionExpiration includes cutoff.

cases.scenario: Account cutoff equals or precedes now
cases.expected_details: SQL combines account and session cutoff; earliest durable authority wins.

cases.scenario: Existing active row bound to correctly signed JWS with non-Active purpose
cases.expected_details: Purpose comparison is ordinal; reject, do not promote.

cases.scenario: Existing current row; access JWS signed with another key
cases.expected_details: TOKEN_FAILED_VALIDATION; no identity published.

cases.scenario: Existing current row; JWS issuer differs from configured issuer
cases.expected_details: Issuer validation rejects.

cases.scenario: Signed JWS missing webKey, purpose or JTI; vary each separately
cases.expected_details: TOKEN_VALIDATION_MALFORMED; whitespace is missing.

cases.scenario: No Bearer or AccessToken header
cases.expected_details: Continue anonymous; protected Authenticate emits 401; no cache/DB operation.

cases.scenario: Both valid Bearer and AccessToken headers contain different credentials
cases.expected_details: Use nonempty Bearer first; test fallback when Bearer empty or unsupported scheme.

cases.scenario: Cached session security stamp differs from SQL row
cases.expected_details: SECURITY_STAMP_MISMATCH; no cache-only authorization.

cases.scenario: Cached account stamp differs from session/account SQL stamp
cases.expected_details: ACCOUNT_SECURITY_STAMP_MISMATCH; cold join also rejects session/account mismatch.

cases.scenario: Trust response has valid but different family/generation from cached projection
cases.expected_details: Middleware rejects identity mismatch without rotation.

cases.scenario: SQL trust response protocol not 2, invalid generation or empty family
cases.expected_details: ReadCachedSessionTrustResultAsync throws invalid dependency response; 503, not Active.

cases.scenario: Account unlock_when in future; valid current cached session
cases.expected_details: SQL ACCOUNT_AUTHORITY_EXPIRED rejects cache trust.

cases.scenario: Account unlock_when in future; no cache; otherwise current row/stamps
cases.expected_details: get_session lacks explicit lock predicate; resolver returns empty capabilities; IsCurrent does not require nonempty capabilities. Paired native fixture must record identity outcome; never claim cold/hot lock parity from this static audit.

cases.scenario: Account verify_status != 1; no cache; otherwise current row/stamps
cases.expected_details: Same explicit account-authority predicate asymmetry as locked_cold. Record current behavior before refactoring; no invented rejection.

cases.scenario: Entitlement NextBoundary <= now; reread returns same identity and current projection
cases.expected_details: May reread authority; use fresh current capabilities and recheck time before publishing.

cases.scenario: Expired entitlement projection; reread changes account/stamps/family/generation
cases.expected_details: No identity on changed authority during refresh.

cases.scenario: Missing/malformed durable entitlement JSON or unsupported capability
cases.expected_details: Explicit Parse rejects; repository wraps as dependency failure; no basic fallback.

cases.scenario: Current basic projection with no permission for requested downstream action
cases.expected_details: Identity authentication is distinct from action authorization; entitlement consumer must deny missing capability. New SVS action mapping belongs to SVS-01+.

cases.scenario: Current source cor20_grant_rights_enabled returns false
cases.expected_details: Preserve basic/rights-disabled projection; do not enable paid rights in SVS-00.

cases.scenario: Cache GET missing; current valid SQL authority
cases.expected_details: One GetSession; successful auth normally hydrates cache.

cases.scenario: Malformed cached payload; current valid SQL authority
cases.expected_details: Best-effort revoke then database lookup/hydration; never trust malformed fields.

cases.scenario: Cache GET timeout/outage; current valid SQL authority
cases.expected_details: Cache failure falls back; writes best effort; durable evidence still required.

cases.scenario: Valid cached projection; SQL trust unavailable
cases.expected_details: Dependency middleware returns 503; no Active from cache.

cases.scenario: No cache; SQL lookup unavailable
cases.expected_details: Repository throws dependency failure; 503 rather than anonymous success.

cases.scenario: Valid SQL/JWT; best-effort SET returns false or times out
cases.expected_details: Recheck expiry/entitlements after cache operation; failure alone does not undo valid authority.

cases.scenario: Initially valid session expires while hydrating cache
cases.expected_details: Post-write and final clock checks reject.

cases.scenario: RequestAborted cancellation during dependency wait
cases.expected_details: Propagate cancellation; publish no identity; exact server HTTP completion is native transport evidence.

cases.scenario: POST /account/refresh with or without trailing slash, case insensitive
cases.expected_details: Skip generic access validation; controller/service must validate opaque refresh credential itself.

cases.scenario: Previously consumed refresh family/generation/credential
cases.expected_details: Separate refresh service rejects stale credential (409); generic Authenticate 401 rule does not describe this endpoint.
